Legal Review and Approval Workflow
features.slice_note: Split into: review/edit UI (Story-level), approval action, and EDGAR-submission-connector (mocked) — the last slice absorbs FR-020's open dependency so the rest isn't blocked by it.

features.mvp_note: Simplified into direct API calls from the dashboard in MVP rather than a dedicated push/stream layer; design (HLD) still specifies the real component.

features.name: Notification System for Filings and Deadlines
features.mvp_note: In-app notifications only; email/SMS channels are designed but not built.

features.name: Compliance Dashboard for Monitoring and Alerts
Accessibility and High Availability Compliance
features.mvp_note: WCAG-conscious UI patterns applied in MVP UI build where free (semantic HTML, keyboard nav); full audit and HA/failover infra out of MVP scope.

features.name: Transaction Data Sync Error Detection and Notification
Edge Case Handling for Rapid Trade Succession
Extensibility for Additional Regulatory Forms
features.mvp_note: The registry abstraction is present in the MVP data/code model (single Form 4 template registered) so the extensibility path is real, even though Form 5/144 templates aren't built.
